text:
Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its soft cheese after routine testing detected Listeria contamination, the Northvale Regional Food Authority announced on 14 March 2025.

Dr. Henrik Voss, the authority's Head of Food Safety, confirmed the recall. It covers 12,400 units sold across 86 retail locations.

The action rests on Northvale Food Authority Recall Notice NFA-2025-0314, which the authority issued after the contamination was identified during routine testing. The notice names the soft cheese as the affected product.

Listeria can cause serious illness, particularly among pregnant women, older people and those with weakened immune systems. Consumers who bought Lindqvist Dairy soft cheese should consult the notice for identifying details of the affected units before eating the product.

The notice, NFA-2025-0314, is the authority's reference document for the recall.
